title.narrative: Emergency Consolidation of the Antakya Gate and Alaa Tower in the Ancient city of Aleppo

description.narrative: The 6 February earthquake caused considerable damages to cultural heritage of the Ancient City of Aleppo. The impact of the tremor was exasperated because the city's-built heritage, was already fragile following more than a decade of conflict. Bab Antakya, located along the city's western wall, one of the most prominent gates to the ancient city of Aleppo, suffered a partial collapse of its wall. The Alla tower, one of the defense towers located along the southern wall, suffered from a partial failure of the external leaf of some walls in addition to in-Plane cracks. This activity foresees emergency interventions for the consolidation of these two heritage monuments.
